# When In Manila

> > When In Manila is the premier lifestyle and events guide covering entertainment, dining, travel, shopping, and cultural happenings in Manila and across the Philippines.

Founded by Vince Golangco, When In Manila (WhenInManila.com) serves as a comprehensive resource for locals and visitors exploring Manila's vibrant scene, featuring everything from restaurant reviews and concert announcements to travel guides and charitable initiatives like the Francis Magalona Foundation's character development programs.

## Key Topics

- Manila lifestyle and events
- Philippine travel destinations
- Restaurant and dining reviews
- Concert and entertainment coverage
- Shopping and fashion in Manila
- Cultural events and exhibitions
- Charity and community initiatives
- Francis Magalona Foundation
- International travel guides
- Theater and Broadway shows
- Beauty and wellness services
- Food and culinary experiences
- Youth education programs
- Manila nightlife and entertainment
- Local business spotlights

- [Surfing in La Union with Surfista Travels](https://www.wheninmanila.com/surfing-in-la-union-with-surfista-travels): Surfista Travels surf lessons and group trips to San Juan, La Union
